purpose: Define remote writes as explicitly delegated mutation operations over exact targets, never as an implied consequence of read access, EXT registration or transport capability.

owns: DWH Remote Write Delegation Boundary semantics

value.default_rule: Remote DWH access is read-only unless explicit write delegation exists.
value.delegation_rule: Write delegation binds exact peer/identity, target resource/operation, allowed mutation scope and applicable lifetime/profile.
value.target_rule: Remote write resolves exact destination instance/schema/record/field before mutation.
value.operation_rule: Remote mutation uses the normal DWH write/patch/transaction contracts.
value.authorization_rule: Target-side AccessCore/governance is evaluated at execution time.
value.nonexpansion_rule: Delegated remote rights cannot exceed the declared delegation even if the remote caller has broader unrelated/local rights.
value.transport_rule: Ability to send a packet/request never implies remote write permission.
value.revocation_rule: Delegation revocation is explicit and prevents future writes without rewriting prior audit evidence.
